summary: Completed live frontend runtime validation for MIS Reports update on preview URL using admin credentials. Verified Delivery history is default/active, Summary tab is absent, Schedules tab and Create schedule flow work (open/cancel without save), ledger shows recipient count (no email strings), section labels are human-readable, and recipient emails remain collapsed until expanded then collapse again.

design_issues.screen: Global app runtime during login/dashboard mount
issues: Console warnings repeatedly observed: chart container width/height resolves to -1.
Console errors observed: React key prop spread into JSX (Area/Bar).
When opening MIS delivery detail sheet, accessibility warning appears: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent.

action_items: Fix global chart runtime warnings/errors (width/height -1 and key prop spread warnings) to keep console clean.
Add Dialog/Sheet accessible description (or aria-describedby) in MIS delivery detail panel to remove runtime accessibility warning.
No functional MIS regressions found for requested tab/ledger/label/recipient-toggle behaviors.
critical_code_review_comments: MIS tabs/default state and recipient privacy requirements are correctly implemented in current code.
MISReportWizard uses data-testid=mis-wizard-back-button for cancel at step 1; there is no dedicated mis-wizard-cancel-button test id.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Primary MIS acceptance checks are functionally passing on live preview. If retesting, focus only on console hygiene and accessibility warning cleanup; avoid Send Now and data mutation paths.
rca of the issue: No requested MIS functional bug reproduced. Remaining findings are runtime console/a11y quality issues: unrelated dashboard chart rendering warnings/errors appear during login/dashboard mount; MIS detail sheet warning is due to missing description metadata for dialog content.
